links.outcome: Objective readability of chatbot responses (FRE, LIX, WSF) versus recommended health literacy levels
links.effect: Responses were difficult to read (FRE 43.1 ± 9.1; LIX 52.8 ± 6.2; WSF 11.2 ± 1.6), exceeding recommendations, though 83-90% of patients perceived them as clear.
links.quote: Chatbot responses were objectively written at a difficult reading level, exceeding recommendations for optimized health literacy.

screen.reason: Empirical study testing a GPT-4 speech-based chatbot with actual urological patients to assess readability metrics versus patient perception, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
